elements.label: Dresden (In Fire)
elements.description: I know it. The Wolf has set a trial for me there. The Wolf's flames have torn everything apart; nothing remains there anymore... only that woman, and the relic I must obtain. [Dresden has become a City in Fire. You cannot complete the main mission there, but you may directly call upon the Wolf's aid, and you will not bear the guilt of burning the city. While the Guardian is still present, other Long will not interfere with this trial.]

elements.label: Guardian of the Spear of Suffering
elements.description: This person is blessed—or cursed—by the Wolf's radiance. It granted her great power, but she cannot always control it. For some reason, I always feel that I must face her, sooner or later. As for her nemesis? One who has awaited death since ascension does not need a life-sustaining hatred.

elements.label: Lost Item
elements.description: Perhaps I can retrieve it someday in the future.

elements.label: Infamy?
elements.description: Taking the treasure is not necessarily evil, but my actions have drawn someone's attention. [While this card exists, you will encounter a dreadful force in the wilderness. At the same time, as long as you still hold something someone likes, even if you have escaped her sight, there is always a chance she will catch up.]

Once a place of glory, now a place of lament. This convent was established in the eleventh century by a branch of the Raveline family from the German-French region, dedicated to 'the Sun and the wolves that hunt its enemies.' Of course, the Intercalation changed this convent, and changed its patron as well, but both have endured to this day, albeit through dark transformations. I know that woman is inside, and the time has finally come for me to face her. [This mission will inevitably fail after reaching a certain stage, but you may then launch an attack on the Guardian.]

elements.label: Uninvited Guest?
elements.description: A woman who appears sorrowful yet noble, but I always feel she has some resemblance to my mentor.

elements.label: Clara von Stein
elements.description: "Those who come near the relic are all murderers of my sister... She is, and so am I.

elements.label: Within the Hall
elements.description: The relic is upon the altar. Firelight shines in from outside, casting long shadows before the altar. She paces at the boundary between light and dark; the sound of her Mary Janes is clearly audible amid the burning. I take a deep breath...

elements.label: An Opening?
elements.description: The process of crushing me is her pleasure; so when she is fully satisfied, she may grow careless.

elements.label: Clara's Wound
elements.description: This cannot mar her beauty, but it is enough to bring her one step closer to death. [The more severely wounded she is, the stronger Clara's onslaught becomes.]

elements.label: Intent: Uninvited Guest?
elements.description: What exactly is the sacred object I saw behind her?

elements.label: Intent: Clara von Stein?
elements.description: The Guardian of the Spear of Suffering? Why is she here, and why does she demand my treasure? I have a premonition that I will eventually face her; I need to understand more.

elements.label: Intent: Clara and Mathilde
elements.description: Clara was originally a rich young lady of Dresden. A great failure upon the keys, an eternal doubt about talent and elegance. In salons and balls, a piercing emptiness beneath the splendor. In her veins flowed a violence she dared not express. Only Mathilde von Stein, her younger sister... only her sister was willing to listen to her, only her sister could make her forget pain. But she is gone... Her sister liked these novelties, so she took this journey as a kind of mourning. Still, a Wolf-Long should not be so sentimental; I need to return to that day and see for myself.

elements.label: Intent: A Pitiable and Respectable Person?
elements.description: A victim, one who wanted to lock away her pain in the convent yet was forced to kill her own kin. But as I let out a long sigh, I somehow felt something was odd. How was she chosen by the Wolf? And that black-eyed woman... a high existence, yet she would 'disregard that lord's feelings' and borrow the relic to take revenge on mortals? Only the Wolf can tell me the answer. [Place the Intent into the City in Fire to hear the Wolf's account.]

elements.label: Dreadful Insight
elements.description: An elegant, hypocritical, and beautiful piece of scum—hateful yet respectable. The entire story, even her sister herself, is either an anecdote from another history or a complete fantasy. She chose to 'kill' her sister so that she could destroy all who come near with a clear conscience, and even continue wearing the mask called 'nobility.' If I point out this cold fact before her, she will certainly lose her composure. [Using this Insight will weaken Clara's threshold, but it will also cause her to lose control.]
